thread:
pagerduty-bot: [P1] Alert: auth-proxy detected mirrored session traffic to S3 logs in us-west-2. Spike on /session from a small set of IPs. Possible log-forwarding misconfig. Paging @oncall-maya. https://incidents.redwood/incident/1719865432 :rotating_light:
oncall-maya: acked. I'm on it — checking k8s svc, ingress, and recent deploys. Any signs of customer-facing 5xxs?
eng-john: quick look at edge: tiny 502 blip ~2min, not widespread. Sample log shows repeated GET /session with very large cookie payloads. snippet: ```[{"ip":"52.12.34.56","principal":"svc-ingest","cookie":"session=eyJ..."}]```
sec-aaron: that cookie looks like a token. If service tokens are being logged we should rotate affected svc accounts immediately and treat as potential disclosure. Recommend rotate svcacct-ingest, revoke tokens, and enable temporary WAF block for the source IPs. @infra-sam can you take rotation? :warning:
infra-sam: starting rotation for svcacct-ingest now. Running: `redwood-iam rotate --principal=svcacct-ingest --reason=incident-1719865432`. ETA ~3m. Will push new creds to dedicated pools and update k8s secret `secret-ingest`.
sre-tilly: applying WAF rule to block 52.12.34.56/32 and related CIDRs; pausing log-forwarder job in staging to isolate. Also increasing sampling on session endpoints.
oncall-maya: do we have confirmed customer impact?
eng-john: no verified customer-facing failures beyond that brief spike. user-facing errors +0.3% for ~2 minutes, then back to baseline. Tentative: limited/no customer impact. Monitoring.
sec-aaron: please run a safe search for token patterns in logs and redact before sharing. e.g. `grep -R "session=" s3://redwood-logs/2024-07-*/ | head`. If any PHI/PII appears, escalate to legal @legal-lena immediately. Do not post raw tokens in public channels.
infra-sam: rotation complete. Secrets updated and k8s rollout initiated: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/ingest` — pods coming up with new creds. New token: svcacct-ingest-v2 (stored in secure vault).
oncall-maya: thanks. Mitigations: rotated keys, WAF blocks, paused forwarder, increased sampling. Keeping channel open to watch for token reuse.
pagerduty-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-20240731-1719865432 — assigned: oncall-maya, sec-aaron, infra-sam, eng-john, sre-tilly.
sec-aaron: archiving sanitized samples to secure bucket for forensics. Reminder: no screenshots or copy/paste of raw tokens. Also scheduling postmortem with infra to review forwarder ACLs and least privilege.
legal-lena: on standby. If customer data exposure confirmed, call me and we'll scope notification.
oncall-maya: monitoring for 30m then reconvene. If no evidence of token reuse/exfil we'll move to mitigations-only and close. :white_check_mark:
